summary_md: Today’s batch clusters around companies in transition, from deliberate restructurings to speculative pivots. The sharpest contrast is between DGXX’s crisp AI data center execution—already generating revenue on NVIDIA hardware with a debt-free balance sheet—and STRS, where leadership’s top priority is restoring its Bitcoin-linked preferred shares from distressed levels, testing a crypto treasury model. Turnarounds feature prominently: JCTC is shrinking revenue to exit low-margin fencing, buoyed by a large insider purchase, while BEEP’s parking portfolio shows a volume-driven inflection as short interest collapses. Insider buying also surfaces at HNRG and OPAL, though OPAL’s renewable gas growth remains overshadowed by persistent sell-side doubt. Regulatory tailwinds aid utilities RGCO and UTL, while UFI waits for tariff-driven reshoring that hasn’t yet shifted analyst sentiment.
